recommended_approach: Blender Cloth with a Wind force field, using a Pin Group for the two clothespin attachment areas and enabling cloth collisions/self-collision for a wind-driven sheet-on-clothesline setup.

key_parameters.Pin Group: Create a vertex group for the two pinned regions where the sheet is held on the line/clothespins.
key_parameters.Stiffness: Set high for the pinned vertices so the attachment points hold their target positions strongly.

warnings: The cloth object must have collisions enabled to participate in collisions.
Enable self-collision to help prevent self-penetration in strong billowing motion.
Collision settings trade accuracy against speed; clipping/tearing issues typically require more careful collision setup.
If the simulated cloth looks blocky, smooth it after simulation with a Subdivision Surface modifier or mesh smoothing workflow.
If using armature-based pinning/control, set the armature to its bind pose before simulation/pose changes.
alternative_approaches: Cloth on Armature or Cloth with Animated Vertex Groups for more art-directed gust timing while still using Cloth.
Soft Body as a simpler deformable-motion fallback if full fabric behavior is not required or Cloth becomes unstable.
